absent_row: UNKNOWN_NO_ADMISSIBLE_SOURCE unless stored completeness/status metadata proves HALT/NO_TRADE; no-trade minute omission alone cannot prove complete response.

additional_provider_authorization.API_constraint: Published endpoint supports code/date but no time filter. Do not silently broaden authorized acquisition to whole-day rows; retain out-of-window zero. If narrow transport cannot be guaranteed, record unresolved acquisition-boundary contract instead of downloading wider data.
additional_provider_authorization.access_prerequisite: existing authenticated entitlement; no purchases/login credentials requested through source code

auction_fallback: Only if no admissible regular trade; exact Entry-session15:30 J-Quants row with finite positive equal O=H=L=C and positive Vo/Va (official source time semantics), or pre-existing authoritative exact auction execution receipt. Never daily Close/last trade.
cross_source_conflict: No price-based choice: inconsistent exact source => LINEAGE_CONFLICT fail-closed; retain all inputs.
frozen_row_lineage: Use pinned Frozen component hashes and per-path sourceHash; new raw responses get request/response hashes and retrieval time.
primary_execution: Earliest admissible trade minute >=920 and <925, after the intent micro-event; reference price=raw Open. minute-start timestamp is a reference label; actual trade second UNKNOWN.
regular_validation: Finite positive O/H/L/C, internally consistent OHLC, Vo>0, Va>0; dated TSE regular minute. OHLC/Vo/Va are post-intent outcome validation only.
source_hierarchy: original Frozen saved full raw minute source
existing exact J-Quants cached raw response/source with lineage
authorized minimal additional J-Quants execution-window source
source_sort: Explicit chronological sort; provider array order not guaranteed. Duplicate conflicting exact rows fail-closed.
